outgoing.name: Politics of the United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: Due to the congested nature of the M6 between Birmingham and Manchester, the UK Government is planning to widen the existing motorway to increase capacity.

outgoing.name: United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: The M6 motorway is the longest motorway in the United Kingdom.
